raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Update the ROCm images from AITER 2bb549102 to [ROCm/aiter@285579b62](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/commit/285579b6211b0da30f35b91a890c29c823597cd1). The new pin is 151 upstream commits ahead of the current default and is the candidate validated by AITER Scout #172.
Scout #172 compared 285579b62 against 2bb549102 — the currently shipped pin — and returned NO_NEW_REGRESSION: of 276 matched cells, zero failed with both controls passing. The four non-pre-existing cells were each taken to hardware rather than argued from logs.

## Modifications

Update AITER_COMMIT_DEFAULT for the eight gfx942/gfx950 ROCm image flavors: 2bb549102 → 285579b62.
Note that this makes the pin non-uniform across stages for the first time since gfx1250 was unified onto the shared pin.

## Accuracy Tests

Not run locally; this Docker dependency update requires AMD GPU image/accuracy CI. Docker is not available in the local environment.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run as a gate.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
